## fvecSim
#---------


diploSHIC fvecSim diploid $inFile.msOut.gz $inFile.diploid.fvec --totalPhysLen 110000 --maskFileName Anopheles-gambiae-PEST_CHROMOSOMES_AgamP3.accessible.fa.gz --chrArmsForMasking all

## fvecVcf
#---------

diploSHIC fvecVcf diploid wilding.allchr.unifiedGenotyper.cov14x.passQC.20indperpop.vcf.gz $chr $chrLen $pop.$chr.w110000.fvec --targetPop $pop --sampleToPopFileName wilding.samples_pops.txt --winSize 110000 --maskFileName Anopheles-gambiae-PEST_CHROMOSOMES_AgamP3.accessible.fa.gz  2> $pop.$chr.w110000.log


## make training and testing set
#-------------------------------

# make trainng set
mkdir $dirtrain/rawFVFiles/ $dirtrain/trainingSets/
mv $dirtrain/*.fvec $dirtrain/rawFVFiles/
python ~/bin/diploSHIC/diploSHIC.py makeTrainingSets $dirtrain/rawFVFiles/Neut.msOut.diploid.fvec $dirtrain/rawFVFiles/Soft $dirtrain/rawFVFiles/Hard 5 0,1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10 $dirtrain/trainingSets/

# make testing set
mkdir $dirtest/rawFVFiles $dirtest/testingSets
mv $dirtest/*fvec $dirtest/rawFVFiles
python ~/bin/diploSHIC/diploSHIC.py makeTrainingSets $dirtest/rawFVFiles/Neut.msOut.diploid.fvec $dirtest/rawFVFiles/Soft $dirtest/rawFVFiles/Hard 5 0,1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10 $dirtest/testingSets/


## train
#-------

python ~/bin/diploSHIC/diploSHIC.py train $dirtrain/trainingSets/ $dirtest/testingSets/ $prefix.bfsModel --confusionFile $prefix.confusionFile.pdf


## predict
#---------

diploSHIC predict $prefixModel.bfsModel.json $prefixModel.bfsModel.weights.hdf5 /wilding/selection/diploshic/$prefix.2L.w110000.diploid.fvec $prefixModel.2L.mossie.preds
diploSHIC predict $prefixModel.bfsModel.json $prefixModel.bfsModel.weights.hdf5 /wilding/selection/diploshic/$prefix.2R.w110000.diploid.fvec $prefixModel.2R.mossie.preds
diploSHIC predict $prefixModel.bfsModel.json $prefixModel.bfsModel.weights.hdf5 /wilding/selection/diploshic/$prefix.3L.w110000.diploid.fvec $prefixModel.3L.mossie.preds
diploSHIC predict $prefixModel.bfsModel.json $prefixModel.bfsModel.weights.hdf5 /wilding/selection/diploshic/$prefix.3R.w110000.diploid.fvec $prefixModel.3R.mossie.preds
diploSHIC predict $prefixModel.bfsModel.json $prefixModel.bfsModel.weights.hdf5 /wilding/selection/diploshic/$prefix.X.w110000.diploid.fvec $prefixModel.X.mossie.preds
